sql.if: , matching_orders AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT o.* FROM pur_order o )

mapper.sql: SELECT o.id, o.company_id, o.no, o.supplier_id, s.short_name AS supplier_name, s.status AS supplier_status, o.purchase_type, o.product_line, COALESCE(agg.item_count, 0) AS item_count, agg.first_sku_id, o.total_qty, o.total_amount, o.order_date, o.delivery_date, o.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, COALESCE(agg.received_qty, 0) AS received_qty, o.buyer_id, c.short_name AS company_name, o.status, o.version, o.create_by, o.create_time FROM matching_orders pur_order o JOIN sup_supplier s ON s.id = o.supplier_id JOIN bas_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id JOIN bas_company c ON c.id = o.company_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS item_count, SUM(i.received_qty - i.returned_qty) AS received_qty, (array_agg(i.material_sku_id ORDER BY i.seq))[1] AS first_sku_id FROM pur_order_item i WHERE i.purchase_order_id = o.id) agg ON true
mapper.select:
SELECT i.id AS purchase_item_id, o.id AS purchase_order_id, o.no AS purchase_no, o.purchase_type, o.supplier_id, s.short_name AS supplier_name, o.buyer_id, o.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, i.material_sku_id, i.purchase_unit, i.qty, i.received_qty, i.returned_qty, i.offset_in_qty, i.offset_out_qty, COALESCE(i.line_due_date, o.delivery_date) AS due_date, i.expect_date, i.follow_note, i.calc_item_id, o.create_by FROM pur_order_item i JOIN pur_order o ON o.id = i.purchase_order_id JOIN sup_supplier s ON s.id = o.supplier_id JOIN bas_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id WHERE o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'RUNNING') AND i.received_qty - i.returned_qty + i.offset_in_qty - i.offset_out_qty < i.qty AND o.product_line = ANY(#{scope.lines.values, typeHandler=com.lingmao.scm.common.mybatis.StringArrayTypeHandler}) AND (o.create_by = #{scope.userId} OR o.buyer_id = #{scope.userId}) AND o.supplier_id = #{q.supplierId} AND o.buyer_id = #{q.buyerId} AND COALESCE(i.line_due_date, o.delivery_date) >= #{q.dueDateFrom} AND COALESCE(i.line_due_date, o.delivery_date) <= #{q.dueDateTo}
AND i.id IN (SELECT id FROM keyword_items UNION SELECT ki.id FROM pur_order_item ki JOIN keyword_heads kh ON kh.id = ki.purchase_order_id)

SELECT d.id, d.no, d.kind, d.doc_type, d.status, d.doc_date, w.name AS warehouse_name, COALESCE(agg.purchase_qty, 0) AS purchase_qty, agg.dye_lots_text, d.logistics_no FROM inv_doc d LEFT JOIN bas_warehouse w ON w.id = CASE WHEN d.kind = 'IN' THEN d.to_warehouse_id ELSE d.from_warehouse_id END LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(i.purchase_qty) AS purchase_qty, string_agg(DISTINCT i.dye_lot, ',' ORDER BY i.dye_lot) AS dye_lots_text FROM inv_doc_item i WHERE i.doc_id = d.id) agg ON true WHERE d.source_type = 'PURCHASE_ORDER' AND d.source_id = #{id} AND d.status <> 'VOIDED' ORDER BY d.id
